used.how: Input section: PAD_ID 0xFFFFFFFF past actual_end, mask and clamp before ttnn.embedding; the part test feeds PAD_ID ids to embed
Acks section rule (records final in DRAM before each ack) and test_adapter_acks re-reads every acked record after the chunk syncs
producer fallback replaced with the server's plan, PAD_ID payload and ring_sdpa_reshuffle (producer_case.py), not the producer's own schedule
runner_case checks model_config.FABRIC_PAYLOAD_SIZE in [4352, 15232] before the mesh opens; Adapter section names it
runner subprocess gets TT_METAL_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=600 so the safe runner's dispatch timeout does not kill a waiting runner
decided no kv_slot_layer_ids / acks_in_kv_slot_space: every DS41 layer owns a window cache and acks
the runner test reads the KV back through the table itself (caches.TableReader per config) instead of the producer's built-in MLA/GQA readers
pad-row zeroing and the record-size geometry rule carried over (DeepSeek kv_ack zero_pad_and_ack); dtype chosen bf16 row-major here instead of bfp8 TILE because ratio-2 records are 16 rows
Deployment/KV cache: the block-cyclic period is the served chunk, not DeepSeek's hard-coded 5120
tests open the whole 2x2 mesh with the spec's FABRIC_2D device params (no submesh)

a cache whose record is not one row per token (compressed KV, ratio r: 32/r rows per 32-token record): tables.py and kv_dump_compare assume 32-row records and 576/128 widths
the runner smoke and the K.1 smoke_runner_ok requirement in a partial run that cannot load every layer (added DS41-8)
